summary: Verified the iteration_5 fixes on /ar/card: (1) 3D flip regression fixed by moving overflow-hidden+rounded-2xl OFF .card-face and onto .card-flip-scene wrapper - confirmed via computed styles AND visual flip tests at 1280px desktop and 390px mobile viewports. Front & back both fully readable with NO mirrored/overlapping text after multiple flip cycles. (2) PNG export now captures the real card design via html-to-image on the hidden CardExportTemplate replica - downloaded PNG is 1950x1230px high-res and visually matches the live card design (not a generic template). (3) NEW PDF export produces a print-ready 2-page PDF at exact CR80 dimensions (242.65pt x 153.07pt = 85.6mm x 54mm). (4) Regression: customizer form, wilaya dropdown, save button and verify link all render correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: CardExportTemplate uses lucide-react + Tailwind classes; html-to-image relies on fonts/icons being fully rendered. Consider preloading Arabic web font before capture to guarantee first-attempt fidelity on cold loads (works fine in tests but worth a safety net).
PDF file size is ~19MB due to pixelRatio: 3 on 650x410 template. For a 85.6x54mm card that's overkill; consider pixelRatio: 2 to cut size ~55% while keeping print-quality >= 400dpi.
MembershipCard.tsx is ~366 lines and mixes UI + 2 export flows; acceptable but export functions could be extracted into a hook (useCardExport) for reuse.
